file:
workflow:
  name: audit-mapped-email
  resources:
    default:
      cpu: 1
      memory: 512Mi
      storage: 1Gi
      platform: karta-source-audit
  groups:
  - name: pair
    tasks:
    - name: leader
      lead: true
      image: ubuntu:24.04
      command:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      args:
      - echo attribution-check; sleep 180; echo done
    - name: worker
      lead: false
      image: ubuntu:24.04
      command:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      args:
      - echo attribution-check; sleep 180; echo done
